title: Superior home appliances

paragraphs.text: Hello, Superior Home Appliances. This is Ian here.
Oh, hello, yes. I have a new fridge, and I'm ringing to report a fault with it. I need you to send someone out to have a look at it.
Okay. I'll fill in a customer complaint form and arrange for one of our repair agents to come out to you.
Okay, then.
Now, can I just get some contact details from you for the form? Your name is?
Jessica. Jessica Brown.
Okay. And if I can just get a contact telephone number.
Our home phone number is five-eight-two-three-two-two-one-zero.
Got it. Now, can I get some more details about the fridge?
Well, it's been playing up since yesterday afternoon.
I see. And is it still under warranty?
Well, I should think so. It's only a couple of weeks old.
That's fine then. Now I just need to get some more information about the make and model. Is it a top mount, a bottom mount, or a side-by-side?
The freezer is on top.
And have you got the model number there?
Yes. It's here on the instructions booklet. It's S six five four three nine one X.
Okay, so it's silver in color.
That's right. I thought it was so much nicer than the usual white ones.
Hmm. Now, if I could just get a few details from you. First, when did you buy the fridge?
Well, as I said, it was only a few weeks ago, but I don't have the receipt in front of me at the moment. I do know that it was delivered on the sixth of February.
Okay. Well, I can use that date to search on the computer. Um, hmm, ah, here it is. It says here you bought it on January the 12th. Now, what exactly is wrong with the fridge?
Well, my fridge is fitted with an alarm, and it started to go off. It made an awful noise.
So what was wrong?

Well, when I went to check the freezer, it felt pretty warm. It's 10 degrees, and it should be minus eighteen, so everything is melting. And then the main part of the fridge doesn't seem to be working either.
Mm, I see.
Before you hear the rest of the conversation, you have some time to look at questions six to ten.
I've made a note of that on the form, and I'll pass it on to the service agent.
When can they come and fix it?
Let's find the closest one to you. Um, let's see. That's Ken's Appliances, and they've got two centers in your area, one near the station and another one in the shopping center.
Well, we're miles away from the shopping center, so the station one would be closer.
I'll ring them in a minute. But I should warn you, it could take a day or two for them to get to you.
What? What am I going to do without a fridge?
Look, there's a fridge full of food there, and it's all going off. I'll have to throw it all out, you know.
Yes, I do sympathize.
It's not just that. This is going to affect my business. I run a sandwich shop, and that's where I keep my stock.
Mm, I see. Look, Jessica, if you tell me how much the stock is worth, we can send you a check for that amount, though there is a maximum of two hundred and fifty dollars.

Well, I've just filled it with a 180 dollars worth of meat and salad, so that would be something, I suppose. But how long is my business expected to survive without a fridge? It's just not good enough.
Yes, I understand your concerns, but that's all I can really offer you.
Well, I'd like to speak to someone higher up about this.
Um, I can ask my manager to ring you back by close of business today. Would that be acceptable?
Yes. Thank you.
I do apologize for all the inconvenience. Is there anything else I can help you with?
Actually, there is one more thing. The door has a dent in it on the left-hand side. It wasn't there in the shop, so it must have happened when it was delivered. I'd like that replaced, too.
I'll make a note of that, too. You'll be hearing from us very soon.
